opportunity: decbench:arm-entry-granularity step 2 (PROPOSAL PR #239) — the pointer sub-class
test_name: kuna-analysis entry recall, decbench ARM Cortex-M corpus (16 binaries x 3 opt levels, 48 images, 41378 DWARF entries)
inspiration: decbench:O2-nuttx-nuttx, O2-betaflight-betaflight_STM32F405, O2-cleanflight-cleanflight_DALRCF405, O2-crazyflie-cf2, O2-libopencm3-cdcacm; kuna's own ARM entry-recall measurement (docs/features/ptrentry/analysis.md; step 2 of the arm-entry-granularity proposal). Precision model after Ghidra's OperandReferenceAnalyzer / DataOperandReferenceAnalyzer split.

surface_listing_off.note: ptrentry is a Listing consumer; with the Listing off there is nothing to consume, so the surface is structurally inert.

rejected_guard_table_run_corroboration.note: 2.1pp of precision, all of it in the unverifiable outside-any-DWARF-body bucket, for 311 ground-truth functions.

speed.note: The discovery surface is under 1%. The decompile-all deltas are sub-proportional to the extra functions discovered (nuttx +5.9% functions for +3.96% wall clock; msc.elf +11.9% for +9.73%), i.e. the cost of decompiling more code, not overhead.

catalog_counts.note: Derived from a fresh `phase catalog` capture on the rebased tree (origin/main 208bb155), not by arithmetic; `kuna catalog --check`, the kuna_phases count tests and catalog_bytecompat confirm. peimportcall (#254) is transform-tier despite being P1, so this row is the only one that moved the analysis-tier counter.

notes: Default-OFF. No DIV row: default output is byte-identical. The precision numbers need a human read before any default flip — this is the step of the arm-entry-granularity sequence with a real precision/recall trade-off.
rebased_onto: origin/main 208bb155 (after #252 returncopysplit, #253 itecondlist, #254 peimportcall); the acceptance table re-measured on the rebased build is byte-identical, and the per-binary entry sets differ in 0 of 48 images off and on.
